description: This module provides utilities for analyzing and optimizing Python bytecode, including dead code elimination, jump optimization, stack size analysis, live variable analysis, line number propagation, and exception table handling for Python 3.11+.

classes.name: ReadsWrites
classes.description: Data class for tracking read/write/visited sets during analysis.

classes.name: FixedPointBox
classes.description: Data class for tracking fixed point status during stack size analysis.

classes.name: StackSize
classes.description: Data class representing stack size bounds and fixed point status during analysis.

methods.name: get_indexof
methods.description: Creates a mapping from instruction to its index in the list, asserting each instruction appears only once.

methods.name: remove_dead_code
methods.description: Performs dead code elimination based on reachability analysis.

methods.name: remove_pointless_jumps
methods.description: Removes jumps that jump to the next instruction.

methods.name: propagate_line_nums
methods.description: Ensures each instruction has the correct line number set.

methods.name: remove_extra_line_nums
methods.description: Removes redundant line number annotations before bytecode packing.

methods.name: livevars_analysis
methods.description: Analyzes live variables at a given instruction, considering control flow and exception handling.

methods.name: stacksize_analysis
methods.description: Performs stack size analysis to determine maximum stack depth during bytecode execution.
